impact: A BOJ hike would add to the global tightening wave (Fed hike bets, BOK just hiked) and could strengthen the yen, a headwind for yen-funded risk trades and high-multiple tech, including MU, NBIS and PLTR.
summary: Tokyo core CPI (ex fresh food) rose 2.9% y/y in November from 2.6% in October, a shade below the 3% forecast but the strongest since July 2025. Headline was 2.8% and the ex-fresh-food-and-energy gauge 2.5%. Traders had priced about a 71% chance of a BOJ hike at the Dec 17-18 meeting.
title: Tokyo core CPI 2.9%, highest since July 2025; keeps BOJ December hike in play
